nights.title: Niall Horan: Dinner Party Live On Tour
nights.name: Niall Horan
nights.extract: Niall James Horan is an Irish singer, songwriter, musician, and multi-instrumentalist. He rose to prominence as a member of the boy band One Direction, formed in 2010 on the singing competition The X Factor. The group released five albums and went on to become one of the best-selling boy bands of all time.
